game_concept: A speed quiz set in The Kingdom – Dungeon Stairs, the castle dungeon stairwell: the baker's apprentice must handle goblin raiders while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Score Keeper: Update score, lives and ammo variables after every event while goblin raiders close in.
theme: The Kingdom – Dungeon Stairs: the castle dungeon stairwell
core_gameplay_loop: In Dungeon Stairs, repeat each round: Update score, lives and ammo variables after every event while goblin raiders close in. Each round, a new grain sacks challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the score value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 130 points of grain sacks by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 130, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 1 (intro tier): Score Keeper
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Score Keeper' (Week 1 slot 6), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Dungeon Stairs'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how score changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against goblin raiders in Dungeon Stairs.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 130 within 24 seconds.
